svg.title: DX TimeShift - J1 / ribbon / DIP-16 plug mapping

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: J1 BOX HEADER ↔ 16-WAY RIBBON ↔ DIP-16 IDC PLUG — continuity check sheet

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Standard DIP-IDC plug: conductors 1,2 land on DIP pins 1,16; 3,4 on 2,15; … 15,16 on 8,9. TO BE CONFIRMED on YOUR cable with a meter before first power-up (mandatory).

svg.text: CONTINUITY TESTS (meter on beep / Ω; A–D: all chips and the Nano OUT of their sockets)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable alone. Probe J1-socket hole n (or the cable's pin-1 end) and the DIP plug: conductor n must

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: beep ONLY to the DIP pin in the table (c1→1, c2→16, c3→2 … c16→9). Also check each DIP pin against

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: its two neighbours: no beep (catches a squashed IDC).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable plugged into J1 on the TimeShift. DIP plug pin k ↔ U1 socket pin k must beep for

svg.text: DIP plug pins 15 / 12 / 10 ↔ U3 socket pins 4 / 7 / 9 must beep, and must NOT beep to

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: U1 pins 15 / 12 / 10 (those go to the Nano and the mux A inputs only).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: DIP pin 16 (+5 V) ↔ DIP pin 8 (GND): no dead short (the meter may beep briefly while C1 charges).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Plug orientation in the DX socket (docs/03-install-in-the-dx.md §8.1). DX switched OFF and

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: unplugged from the mains, DIP plug fitted in the U701 socket; chips may stay fitted. Meter on Ω:

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: TP4 ↔ DX U702 pin 8: < 1 Ω. C1 + lead ↔ U702 pin 16: < 1 Ω. TP4 ↔ U702 pin 16: NOT near 0 Ω

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: (may climb as capacitors charge). TimeShift U1 pin 1 ↔ C1 + lead: < 1 Ω.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Record A–E in docs/04-test-and-calibrate.md §1. Any mismatch: STOP, do not power the DX.
